_: Docs for what Skript's own docs (sk gen-docs) don't cover under the same id. 'aliases' joins a NeoSkript element or type to the Skript docs entry it's part of there; 'written' are docs written here, for elements Skript registers but never documents, and for NeoSkript's own. Read by scripts/syntax.mjs.

SecRunOn.name: Run On
description: NeoSkript only. Runs its code on the thread that owns an entity or location. On Folia, each region of the world has its own thread, and only that thread may read the entities and blocks in it, so code that reads something in another region goes in run on.

Getting there and back work like a wait: the trigger carries on on the other thread, at once if this thread already owns it, else on the next tick, then goes back to its own thread after the section. On Paper, where one thread owns everything, the code just runs.
examples:
every 5 seconds:
	loop all players:
		run on loop-player:
			if health of loop-player < 5:
				send "You're low on health" to loop-player

StructExample.name: Example
description: Code that's parsed but never run, as Skript's documentation examples are: it shows how syntax is written, and a script with it still loads. It's experimental, so a script needs using examples first.
examples:
using examples

example:
	send "Hello" to player

CondHasSaddle.name: Has Saddle
description: Checks whether an animal that can be ridden, like a horse, pig or strider, has a saddle on.
examples:
if event-entity has a saddle:
	send "It's ready to ride" to player

EffVectorRotateAroundAnother.name: Vectors - Rotate Around Vector
description: Rotates vectors around another vector by a number of degrees.
examples: rotate {_vector} around vector(0, 1, 0) by 90 degrees

ExprVectorRotateAroundAnother.name: Vectors - Rotated Around Vector
description: Vectors rotated around another vector by a number of degrees, leaving the vectors themselves as they were.
examples: set {_rotated} to {_vector} rotated around vector(0, 1, 0) by 45 degrees

ExprAllFunctions.name: Functions of a Script
description: The functions a script defines, as function references that can be run. It's experimental, so a script needs using reflection first.
examples:
using reflection

on load:
	loop all functions in script "utilities.sk":
		broadcast "%loop-value%"

ExprItemWithItemModel.name: Item With Item Model
description: A copy of items with another item model, which changes how they look to players who have that model in a resource pack.
examples: give player a stick with item model "mypack:wand"

LitAt.name: At
description: The word at as a direction of no distance, so at %location% is the location itself, as in spawn a pig at player.
examples: spawn a zombie at {_location}

LitClassInfo.name: Type
description: A type written as a value: a player, an item type. Used where syntax takes a type, as in %object% is a %type% checks and function references.
examples:
if {_value} is a player:
	send "It's a player"

ExprCast.name: Values of a Type
description: Only the values of a type out of others: players in {_list::*} is the players in the list, and value within X treats X as an object.
examples: set {_players::*} to players in {_entities::*}

ExprEventEntity.name: Event Value
description: A value the event has, named by its type: the player, event-block, the attacker. What each event has is listed under it on the events page.
examples:
on break:
	send "You broke %event-block%" to the player

ExprEventEntityBare.name: Event Value (bare)
description: An event value written as just its type, as in send "Hi" to player in a join event.
examples:
on join:
	send "Welcome, %player%" to player

integer.name: Integer
description: A whole number, like 5 or -12. Where syntax asks for an integer, a number with a fraction is rounded down.
examples: set {_count} to 10

inventoryholder.name: Inventory Holder
description: What has an inventory: a player or other entity, or a block like a chest, furnace or hopper.
examples: set {_holder} to holder of event-inventory

itementity.name: Dropped Item
description: An item lying on the ground, as an entity: what drop makes and players pick up.
examples:
on spawn of dropped item:
	broadcast "Something dropped"

hiddenpotioneffect.name: Hidden Potion Effect
description: A potion effect waiting under another of the same type, which takes over when the stronger one runs out.
examples:
loop hidden potion effects of player:
	broadcast "%loop-value%"

keyedbossbar.name: Keyed Boss Bar
description: A boss bar with a namespaced key, which the server keeps (as /bossbar does) and can be found again by its key.
examples: set {_bar} to boss bar with id "myplugin:event"

fireworktype.name: Firework Type
description: The shape a firework explodes in: ball, large ball, star, burst or creeper face.
examples: launch ball large firework colored red at player

cattype.name: Cat Type
description: A cat's coat: tabby, black, red, siamese, british shorthair, calico, persian, ragdoll, white, jellie or all black. It's written in front of cat, to spawn or check for that kind of cat.
examples: spawn a calico cat at player

if victim is a black cat:
	cancel event

wolfvariant.name: Wolf Variant
description: A wolf's coat, by the biome it comes from: pale, woods, ashen, black, chestnut, rusty, spotted, striped or snowy. It's written in front of wolf, to spawn or check for that kind of wolf.
examples: spawn a snowy wolf at player

if victim is a snowy wolf:
	cancel event

description: Whether all the texts are the same, upper and lower case included. Skript's is compares texts ignoring case; this doesn't.
examples:
case_equals("Hi", "hi") # false
case_equals("Hi", "Hi") # true
